analysis.reasonEn: Daily RSI attempts to exit oversold at 38.7 but remains low. MACD histogram improved to -88.3750 but still negative. Volume ratio below 1.0 for 5 consecutive days indicates weak buying interest. Price is testing the 20-day moving average at 28,177 as resistance after breaking below.

analysis.narrativeEn:
[Trend Position]
· Current price (KRW 25,515) vs SMA5 (KRW 26,114) / SMA20 (KRW 28,177) / SMA50 (KRW 32,718): Below, confirming short- to mid-term trend weakness.
· Position relative to SMA100 (KRW 35,023) / SMA200 (KRW 36,508): Maintaining strong downtrend.
· 52-week position (22.0%) + Current price range near historical lows.
[Momentum Indicators]
· RSI trajectory (36.2→38.7): Failing to exit oversold, attempting to enter neutral zone.
· MACD histogram trajectory (-135.1234→-88.3750): Improving, but weakness persists.
· Bollinger Band current price position (Lower 23,340 / Middle 28,177): Near the middle band, with band width at 34.33% expansion.
[Support & Resistance Structure]
· Swing support (KRW 25,055): Based on 5-day low and Pivot S1 (KRW 21,598).
· Swing resistance (KRW 30,570): Based on 20-day high and Pivot R1 (KRW 31,553).
· 5-day / 20-day high-low pattern (sideways): Weak trend reversal signal.
[Volume & Conclusion]
· Volume ratio (0.90x): Moderate confidence in price movement.
· Current phase diagnosis (Accumulation): Entry for buy on confirmation above 20-day MA at KRW 28,177, entry for sell on breaking below swing support at KRW 25,055.
